name: SaaS Mag

sources.title: Homepage — active SaaS industry publication; sections include SaaS Spotlight (founder interviews), SaaS Founders, Growth Hacks; 'Contribute to SaaSMag' in nav
Contribute page — external contributor form: name, email, company, company bio, position, article file upload (txt/docx/pdf ≤100MB), images, preferred publish date, 'why is your submission valuable'
Full style/content guidelines linked from the contribution form (not fetched)

conditions: Free route is contributing an article — you supply publishable editorial content; there is no product-listing or 'submit your startup' form
Secondary route: founder/CEO interview features ('SaaS Spotlight', 'CEO Insights') — pitch via the contact form, acceptance is editorial
requirements: A written article as a file upload (txt, docx, or pdf, max 100MB)
Prefers new unique content; will accept pieces previously published only on the writer's own personal blog — NOT pieces run on other business/enterprise blogs
Author details: name, email, company, company bio, position
A justification of why the piece is valuable to SaaS entrepreneurs
Read the full submission-guidelines page before drafting — non-compliance is grounds for rejection
preparation: A finished article draft in txt/docx/pdf on a SaaS-business topic (growth, pricing, metrics — not a product advert)
Company bio and author position for the byline
For interview angles: founder availability + a story hook
workflow: Write the article to spec and export as docx/txt/pdf
Open https://www.saasmag.com/contributions/ and complete the form including the file upload
For a founder-feature instead of an article, pitch via https://www.saasmag.com/contact-us/
Wait for editorial review; no tracking is provided
watchFor: This is a publication, not a directory — 'getting listed' means getting an article or interview published
Content rule: pieces that ran on other business blogs are rejected; only personal-blog republication is allowed
Overt product promotion will likely be rejected — write for their audience of SaaS operators
Copyright footer says 2024 but content is current (2026 articles live) — site is active despite the stale footer
countsAsLive: The contributed article or interview is published on saasmag.com under a topic section (Business, SaaS Spotlight, Growth Hacks, etc.) with the company mentioned in the byline/content
unknowns: Review turnaround and whether they notify on rejection
Whether contributor articles carry dofollow links
Whether SaaS Spotlight interviews are editorial-only or can be sponsored
